note: What a server sends to make a unit play an animation. The header names the unit.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: loop
bits.note: Set to loop it.

bits.name: holdLastFrame
bits.note: Set to hold its last frame once it ends.

bits.name: queue
bits.note: Set to play it once the animation playing ends, rather than now.

bits.name: queueLast
bits.note: Set to play it after every animation already waiting.

bits.name: replaceable
bits.note: Set to let the next animation queued after it start at once.

bits.name: locked
bits.note: Locks the unit's animation, where one of the client's own settings is on; later animations sent for the unit are then ignored.

bits.name: noBlend
bits.note: Set to switch to it at once rather than blend in.

bits.name: lockedFromIdle
bits.note: Set where idle animations cannot fade it out.

bits.name: reserved
bits.note: What it does is not recorded for this range; a server writes zero.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: No effect is recorded; a server sends zero.

fields.note: No effect is recorded; a server sends zero.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: Where above zero, how many seconds the animation is stretched or squeezed to span; otherwise it plays at normal speed.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte. Nothing plays for a name the unit does not have.

revisions.note: No start point is carried: the animation starts from its beginning. A unit whose animation has been locked ignores the message.

fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte, the two taking at most 64 bytes. Nothing plays for a name the unit does not have.

revisions.note: scaleTime and startProgress are applied only where above zero. A unit holding a locked animation ignores the message. An animated building plays at normal speed, and keepEmotes has no effect on it.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: locked
bits.note: Set where no other animation can fade this one out.

bits.name: lockedFromIdle
bits.note: Set where idle animations cannot fade it out. It has no effect where locked is set.

bits.name: noBlend
bits.note: Set to switch to it at once rather than blend in.

bits.name: loop
bits.note: Set to loop it.

bits.name: keepEmotes
bits.note: Set to let an emote playing go on; clear stops it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.
